SW data hazard: simulator forwards store data, hardware stalls IF for up to 3 cycles

Simulator: forwards via `tomem.rega_out = d.fwd_alua` in p_execute() when SW has forwarding active.
Hardware: combinational multi-stage detection in hazunit.vhd checks reg_sela_id (SW data register) against ALU/MEM/WB stage producers with regctl != "000" guard.

Same final memory values with NOP-padded programs. HW test programs (no NOPs between producer and SW) give wrong sim results because forwarding grabs the wrong pipeline stage's value.

Reassess after HW Phase 3+ forwarding coverage is complete.
